research_protocol.question: Does retaining frequency position improve the spectrum CNN, with unchanged spectral input and convolutional backbone?
research_protocol.selection_rule: Lowest five-split mean primary metric; report both physical target RMSEs and paired split differences.
research_protocol.confirmation_rule: Freeze the best position-preserving readout before examining new-split results; compare with historical GAP and raw-time references.
research_protocol.limitations: Repeated holdouts share observations and use validation for early stopping. New seeds check stability, not an independent unseen dataset. No hidden-test accuracy claim.
